in_marathi.name: Ashan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Ashan means 'free from' or 'absence of'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asha' which means 'hope' or 'wish'. In Hindu mythology, Ashan is a name given to the divine messenger or a sage who delivers the message of the gods.
